rationale: Enabling picrust activates PICRUSt2 functional profiling using the filtered ASV sequences and abundance table already produced by QIIME2_EXPORT under the baseline configuration. MULTIQC is affected because its inputs include the updated workflow parameter summary and the software versions emitted by PICRUST, while SUMMARY_REPORT receives the newly generated functional pathway prediction files. No existing analytical processes are removed or require changes to their inputs or settings.
